messages:
Maya (Finance): Morning — automated GPU budget monitor flagged an unlabeled surge in project orion-labs from ~00:40-03:20 UTC. Estimated delta $11,250. :rotating_light:
Leo (Eng-ML): Ack. Could be the overnight multi-model sweep. Stopping any active sweeps now.
Sofia (Eng-Platform): We pushed a temporary permissive burst rule to the shared-research pool yesterday evening. Checking whether orion-labs matched the rule.
Maya (Finance): Quick billing snippet from export:
```
project_id | sku | usage_start | cost
orion-labs | GPU hours | 2026-07-08T00:52:00Z | 5600.00
orion-labs | GPU hours | 2026-07-08T02:15:00Z | 5650.00
```
No cost_center label present.
BillBot: Budget "orion-research" is at 130% of its soft threshold; alert routed to #finance.
Ben (SalesOps): Heads-up — if any of these runs were customer-facing, sales needs tagging for billable work. Please verify.
Leo (Eng-ML): Confirmed: this was internal model sweep for baseline tuning, not customer work.
Sofia (Eng-Platform): Found the change: deploy at 2026-07-07T21:40 by infra-svc set burst=true for pool shared-research. Rolling back now and adding a label filter to deny unlabeled projects.
Maya (Finance): Proposed remediation: (1) Snapshot affected rows, (2) retroactively tag those lines cost_center:model-experiments, (3) generate an internal invoice for product for month close, (4) add runtime guard preventing allocation without cost_center label.
Leo (Eng-ML): I'll stop jobs (done) and open a PR to require cost_center in the sweep runner.
Sofia (Eng-Platform): I've rolled back the permissive policy and added a denylist for orion-labs. Also adding an early alarm at 50% of baseline for that pool.
Maya (Finance): I'll run the backfill after snapshot. Snapshot saved: gs://finance/snapshots/orion-1839999999.csv. Creating ticket FIN-2026-805.
Maya (Finance): Backfill SQL I plan to run (snapshot first):
```
UPDATE billing.gcp_lines
SET labels = ARRAY_CONCAT(labels, ['cost_center:model-experiments'])
WHERE project_id = 'orion-labs' AND usage_start_time BETWEEN '2026-07-08T00:30:00Z' AND '2026-07-08T03:30:00Z';
```
Ben (SalesOps): Thanks — product confirms internal absorb under "model-experiments" budget. Please CC me on the draft invoice.
Maya (Finance): Owners: Maya -> snapshot + backfill + invoice; Leo -> PR for guard + stop jobs; Sofia -> rollback + monitoring. Target EOD 2026-07-08.
BillBot: Note: retro tags will update internal attribution dashboards only; cloud provider invoice is unchanged.
Leo (Eng-ML): PR opened and tests passing.
Sofia (Eng-Platform): Monitoring alert added and deny rule in place.
Maya (Finance): I'll post invoice draft here when ready and close FIN-2026-805 after backfill. Thanks all.
